versions.content:
# Events policies

- Contracts and amendments up to $10,000: the Director of Events signs. Over $10,000: the Executive Director.
  Staff may negotiate but not sign.
- Attendee data: registrants choose at registration whether to share their contact details with exhibitors
  (field share_with_exhibitors). Exhibitors and sponsors receive only opted-in contacts, name, company, title
  and email. Never phone numbers or the full list.
- Accessibility: we provide reasonable accommodations requested at registration or later (captioning, ASL,
  mobility, dietary). Ask the attendee what works; confirm in writing.
- PDH certificates: 1 PDH per 60 minutes of instruction, for sessions the attendee is recorded as attending
  (badge scan). Breaks, meals and exhibits earn none.

# Group sales agreement, GLSFE Fall Technical Conference, Nov 4-6, 2026 (signed 2025-12-02)

Room block: 110 rooms on Wed 11/4 and 110 on Thu 11/5 (220 room-nights) at $189 + tax. Cutoff: Monday 11/2,
17:00 ET; unreserved rooms release to general inventory.
Attrition: the group will pick up at least 80% of the block (176 room-nights), measured cumulatively after
cutoff. Shortfall is billed at the group rate per room-night, less any shortfall rooms the hotel resells.
Food and beverage: final guarantees due by 12:00 noon ET three business days before each function (Monday 11/2
for Thursday's functions). The guarantee may not be lower than 90% of the contracted count. The group is billed
for the guarantee or the actual number served, whichever is greater. The hotel sets 3% over the guarantee.
Contracted counts: breakfast 400, lunch 400, reception 350.
Charges: 24% service charge on food and beverage; 6% Michigan sales tax on food, beverage and service charge.

documents.title: How we set guarantees (Events team method)

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
1. Use registrations as of Monday 08:00. 2. Apply our show rates from the last three Fall conferences:
breakfast 78%, lunch 92%, reception 64%. 3. Round up. 4. Apply the contract floor (90% of contracted count,
rounded up). 5. The guarantee is the higher of steps 3 and 4. 6. Note the hotel's 3% overset. 7. Send Simone
the counts with dietary needs before noon.

# Fall Technical Conference 2026: registration terms

- Fees (regular, from 10/1): member $395, non-member $545, student member $95. Speakers complimentary. The member
  rate applies to anyone whose membership is current on the day of the event; staff correct a wrong rate and
  Finance refunds the difference to the card.
- Substitutions: free, any time up to and at the event. A non-member substituting for a member pays the $150
  difference.
- Cancellations: by Thursday 10/22, refund less a $50 fee. After 10/22, no refunds; substitution instead. The
  Director of Events may approve a credit toward a future GLSFE event for an emergency; the registrant's own
  short note is enough, never medical records.
- Guests (not registered): lunch and reception tickets only, sold at our cost (the BEO price plus the hotel's 24%
  service charge and 6% tax). Guests earn no PDH.
- Walk-ins on site: the regular rate, card only, at the registration desk.
- Photography: GLSFE photographs the event for its own communications; registrants who ask not to be
  photographed get a no-photo sticker on their badge, and the photographer avoids them.

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# Sponsorship levels and recognition

Fall Technical Conference 2026 levels: platinum $15,000 (one); gold $7,500; silver $3,000; lanyard $3,000;
coffee break $3,000. Corporate Relations (Jada Reyes) sells; Events (Harper Quinn) approves recognition copy
and placement.

Benefits. Platinum: premium booth, reception co-branding signage, two lead retrieval licenses, logo on all
signage and in the app, three registrations, the opted-in attendee contacts (under the privacy policy). Gold:
booth, logo on the sponsor board and in the app, one lead retrieval license, two registrations. Silver: booth,
logo on the sponsor board, one registration. Lanyard and coffee break: booth, logo on the lanyards or the break
signs, one registration.

Recognition is acknowledgment, not advertising, so that sponsorship payments stay qualified sponsorship payments
for tax purposes (26 CFR 1.513-4). Allowed: the sponsor's name and logo; slogans without qualitative or
comparative claims; locations, phone numbers and web address; value-neutral descriptions of its product lines.
Not allowed anywhere in recognition (signs, app, slides, emails): qualitative or comparative language ("best",
"leading", "#1"), prices, discounts or other savings, endorsements, or calls to buy. Advertising is sold
separately by Corporate Relations and booked by Finance as advertising income.

documents.title: Travel, expenses and payments to individuals

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# Travel, expenses and payments to individuals

- Mileage in a personal car on GLSFE business: the IRS business standard mileage rate in effect on the day of
  travel (76 cents a mile for travel from July 1, 2026), from the office and back. Standard distances: office
  (Ann Arbor) to downtown Detroit (the Henley, Huntington Place) 43 miles each way; to Columbus 190; to
  Indianapolis 255. Parking and tolls at cost, with receipts. Expense reports in Expensify within 30 days,
  approved by the manager.
- Staff hotel nights on event duty go on the event's master account, not on expense reports.
- Honoraria are paid only under a signed speaker agreement. Finance needs a W-9 on file before paying any
  individual, and files Form 1099-NEC when an individual's nonemployee compensation from GLSFE for the calendar
  year reaches the IRS reporting threshold ($2,000 for payments made in 2026).
- Invoices: the staff member who ordered the goods or services checks the invoice against the order and approves
  it in Bill.com; Finance pays. Disputed lines are taken up with the vendor before approval.
- Bank details: Finance changes a vendor's bank details only after calling the vendor at a number already on
  file. Emails announcing new bank details are reported to IT.

# Henley Hotel Detroit: exhibits addendum to the group sales agreement (exhibitor rules)

- Floor plan: 18 tabletop booths (8 x 8 ft, one 6-ft table) in the Grand Foyer, per the plan the hotel had
  approved by the Detroit Fire Marshal on 10/9. No added booths, tables or displays in aisles, exits or the
  registration area.
- Insurance: each exhibitor gives GLSFE a certificate of insurance before move-in, commercial general liability
  of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence, naming Henley Hotel Detroit and GLSFE as additional insureds. No
  certificate, no move-in.
- Not permitted without a Fire Marshal permit, applied for through the hotel at least 30 days before the event:
  open flame, propane or any other compressed flammable gas, fueled equipment, vehicles.
- Drape, signs and decorations must be flame-retardant (NFPA 701 certificate on request).
- Shipping: boxes from Mon 11/2, labeled "Hold for GLSFE / exhibitor name / booth number / arriving 11/4".
  Package handling $15.00 per box, charged to the exhibitor at pickup.
- Move-in Wed 11/4 13:00-18:00. Booths staffed Thu 07:00-18:00. Move-out after 18:00 only: no early teardown
  (carts in the Foyer during the reception are a safety hazard).
- Electrical: 20-amp outlet $95, ordered through Meridian AV.
- Food and beverage: hotel catering only; no outside food, beverage or alcohol.
